🍌🥧 HEALTHY VEGAN BANANA CREAM PIE FOR MAXIMUM WEIGHT LOSS!! 😍🔥
ONLY 165 CALORIES PER SLICE!! 🤯
🌱 Vegan | Oil-Free | Low-Calorie-Density | Holiday Dessert!
🔗 Click the LINK IN MY BIO to check out my Holiday eBook packed with OVER 65 delicious Thanksgiving & Christmas recipes for maximum weight loss! ❤️
I LOST 66 LBS EATING A TON OF DELICIOUS SWEET TREATS JUST LIKE THIS!! 🙌
And this banana cream pie might just be one of my FAVOURITES!
A delicious chickpea and rice cake crust, layers of sweet banana custard, fresh banana slices and the FLUFFIEST topping made from CHICKPEA WATER! ☁️
YES, CHICKPEA WATER!! 🤯
It's called AQUAFABA, and it whips up into the most amazing fluffy topping!
And the BEST part?!
Each BIG, satisfying slice is ONLY 165 CALORIES! 😍
OH MY MUFFINS!! 🤤❤️
✨ INGREDIENTS ✨
🥧 CRUST:
• 1 tin chickpeas, drained and rinsed
• 6 rice cakes
• ⅔ banana
• 3 spoonfuls PB2 powder
• A few sweetener drops
• Pinch of salt
🍌 BANANA CUSTARD:
• Very ripe bananas
• Soy milk
• Vanilla extract
• Cornstarch
• Pinch of salt
• Optional: pinch of turmeric for colour
• Optional: PB2 powder
☁️ AQUAFABA TOPPING:
• Reserved liquid from the chickpea tin
• 1 tsp cream of tartar
• ⅓ cup sugar or granulated sweetener
🍌 FOR ASSEMBLY:
• Fresh banana slices
👩‍🍳 HOW TO MAKE MY BANANA CREAM PIE:
1️⃣ MAKE YOUR CRUST! 🥧
Drain your chickpeas, but DON'T throw away that precious liquid!
Add the chickpeas to a food processor with 6 rice cakes, ⅔ banana, PB2 powder, sweetener drops and salt.
Blend until combined, then press the mixture firmly into your pie pan.
2️⃣ MAKE YOUR BANANA CUSTARD! 🍌
Add very ripe bananas, soy milk, vanilla, cornstarch and salt to a blender.
Blend until smooth.
For a more traditional custard colour, add a TINY pinch of turmeric.
You can also add PB2 if you love peanut butter as much as I do! 😂
Pour into a saucepan and heat, stirring CONSTANTLY until beautifully thick.
Pop it into the freezer to cool.
3️⃣ MAKE YOUR FLUFFY TOPPING! ☁️
Take the reserved chickpea liquid and add cream of tartar.
Whisk until thick, fluffy stiff peaks form!
Gradually add your sugar or granulated sweetener while whisking.
And YES, you just made a gorgeous fluffy topping from chickpea water! 🤯
4️⃣ ASSEMBLE YOUR PIE! 🥧
Grab your prepared crust and arrange fresh banana slices over the bottom.
Spoon your cooled banana custard over the top.
Then add your beautiful aquafaba fluff!
Pipe it on if you're feeling fancy, or simply spread it over the top!
5️⃣ SLICE & ENJOY! 😍
And there you have it!
A gorgeous VEGAN BANANA CREAM PIE that's creamy, fluffy, sweet and absolutely DELICIOUS!
ONLY 165 CALORIES PER SLICE! 🤯❤️
This is exactly why I LOVE low-calorie-density eating!
I lost 66 lbs without giving up delicious desserts or BIG portions.
And this is the kind of sweet treat that makes healthy eating so much FUN! 💚

Eating less isn't always the answer.
For years, we've been told that if we want to lose weight, we need to eat less.
So we skip meals, cut portions, avoid carbs and try to get by on as little food as possible.
But here's where that approach can backfire, especially in midlife.
When you're constantly trying to eat less, you're often missing out on the very things that make fat loss easier to manage.
Protein to help keep you full and maintain muscle.
Fibre to support digestion, gut health and keep hunger in check.
Food volume, so you can eat satisfying meals without consuming excessive calories.
And when you're hungry all the time, it's much harder to stick to your calorie goals. You end up snacking, picking at food or overeating later in the day.
The answer isn't to keep cutting calories.
It's to make the calories you're eating work harder for you.
Build your meals around protein, add plenty of fibre-rich foods and fill your plate with foods that give you more volume for fewer calories.
You still need a calorie deficit to lose fat, but you don't need to spend your days feeling hungry and deprived.
Eating smarter, not just eating less, can make all the difference.

🚨 SMASH OR PASS? FAT LOSS FOOD EDITION 🔥

Some foods LOOK healthy but could be making it harder for you to lose those stubborn 30-50 pounds.

Here’s what I’d smash vs pass if your goal is to get leaner without starving yourself 👇

🥚 Whole Eggs: SMASH ✅
Great source of healthy fats and nutrients, but not as protein-dense as you might think.

🥜 Mixed Nuts: PASS ❌
Healthy fats, but extremely calorie-dense and way too easy to overeat.

🥣 Nonfat Greek Yogurt: SMASH ✅
High protein, low calorie, and keeps you full for hours.

🧃 Fruit Juice: PASS ❌
Easy to drink hundreds of calories without the filling fiber you’d get from whole fruit.

🥔 Boiled Potatoes: SMASH ✅
One of the most filling foods you can eat. Perfect for keeping hunger under control.

🥩 Lean Steak: SMASH ✅
Packed with protein to help preserve muscle while losing fat.

🍿 Air-Popped Popcorn: SMASH ✅
High-volume, low-calorie snack that satisfies those salty cravings.

🥣 Granola: PASS ❌
Small portions pack a TON of calories. Easy to overeat without realizing it.

💪 Whey Isolate: SMASH ✅
One of the easiest and most convenient ways to hit your daily protein goal.

🍫 Protein Bars: PASS ❌
Some are basically candy bars with a little extra protein. Check the calories before grabbing one.

You don’t need to eliminate your favorite foods to lose fat.

You just need to make smarter choices that keep you FULL while staying in a calorie deficit.

That’s how you lose 30-50 pounds without feeling like you’re constantly dieting.

🔥 Follow @cohnan for simple fat loss tips that actually fit your busy lifestyle.
